summary: This video previews high-end Continental Challenge team compositions used on the Chinese server for Season 9. The creator breaks down optimal setups for Dauntless, Aura, Ice Blast, and Corrosion teams against various bosses. Key builds focus heavily on specific rotation timings (15-second vs. 18-second rotations) and high effect resistance to resist boss debuffs. A new mythic chest piece that stacks damage-amplifying debuffs is featured across multiple damage dealers.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Needs 100% crit rate, followed by maximum attack and attack speed runes to maximize shield and damage scaling.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: Built with 75%+ crit rate and massive crit damage, requiring less attack speed than Guinavivre.

heroes.name: Kurvida
heroes.note: Built with high skill haste for a 15-second rotation, high accuracy, and attack to share via mythic gear.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Equipped with Antler's artifact and high accuracy to shield and boost the highest-attack ally.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.note: Uses the Puppeteer set, high accuracy, and resistance to delay and extend debuffs on bosses.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Scales heavily off HP, crit rate, and crit damage, benefiting greatly when paired with max-HP buffers.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Directly replaces Lincos even at Inspiration 0 and can deal substantial supplementary damage.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.note: Provides team-wide haste enabling a 15-second skill rotation that outdamages Celestine and Sagomir variants.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.verdict: Alternative Aura support / Ice Blast enabler
heroes.note: Extends team HP to bolster Talethia's damage output, but is also used in Ice Blast setups.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: Requires full crit rate and pure attack with her exclusive artifact, completely skipping crit damage.

heroes.name: Shinnah
heroes.note: Built with 300+ resistance and 240+ accuracy to prevent team debuffs and shred enemy defenses.

heroes.name: Fredegonda
heroes.note: Built with maximum crit rate, crit damage, and over 250 resistance to stay debuff-free against Stegamoffyn.

heroes.name: Rook
heroes.note: Prioritizes 100% crit rate, max crit damage, and skill haste over raw attack stats.

heroes.name: Szecedith
heroes.note: Equipped with her exclusive artifact, built with high attack, crit rate, and crit damage to maintain corrosion stacks.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Built with maximum HP, Puppeteer set, accuracy, and skill haste to enable a 15-second team rotation.

heroes.name: Reytah
heroes.note: Remains viable at Inspiration 0, building HP, accuracy, and skill haste to extend corrosion debuffs.

teams.note: High-investment Dauntless team tuned around 18s (or 15s with haste) skill timings, utilizing Selva to extend debuffs.
Aura team hitting 2.58B damage; uses Rena for a fast 15-second rotation. Celestine or Sagomir can substitute Rena.
Ice Blast team dealing ~1.6B damage with 18-second skill timings and heavy team-wide resistance (250-300+).
Corrosion team dealing ~1B damage through AoE corrosion stacking, running Rook on default skill timings.

meta_changes: A new mythic chest armor piece is introduced that stacks damage-amplifying debuffs on the boss.
Holfast replaces Lincos in Aura teams as the premier support even at Inspiration 0.
15-second rotation cycles enabled by Rena's haste significantly outperform standard 18-second rotations in Aura compositions.
tips: For Guinavivre and Rook, guarantee 100% crit rate before focusing on secondary stats.
Beldelle in Ice Blast should skip crit damage completely and stack pure crit rate and attack.
Aim for 250-300+ effect resistance on supports when fighting bosses like Stegamoffyn to prevent deadly debuff loops.
Build Child of Chaos with accuracy and skill haste runes so your Corrosion team can sync on 15-second rotations.
